newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: De Beers recovers on Russian co-operation.
newsitem.headline: De Beers recovers on Russian co-operation.

text.p: After a severely weak day, De Beers shares regained most of their lost ground after news the Russia would co-operate with the diamond giant on the matter of signing a new marketing agreement, dealers said.

De Beers on Wednesday gave the Russian authorities an ultimatum which stated they had to ratify the new diamond deal by the end of the year. De Beers said that after December 31 it would no longer buy diamonds under the old agreement.
By 1307 GMT De Beers' shares were only 50 cents weaker at 129 rand, having fallen in early trade as far as 121.75 rand per share from an opening price of 128 rand.
Dealers said then shares could fall as far as 100 rand.
Shares recovered steadily throughout the day but the latest announcement by the Russian Finance Ministry that it would co-operate with De Beers gave stocks a huge boost.
Volumes were large with 448,200 shares changing hands.
